title: Three text errors in item descriptions and in userItems.md
author: Claude-JG
description: (1) definitions/itemDefsObjects.py, ObjectJointSpherical, constrainedAxes: the description speaks of translation (0,1,2) and rotation (3,4,5) axes, the array has three entries. (2) ObjectJointGeneric, detailedDescription, the table of joint J1 orientation vectors: a stray v in v\tv_{z1}, which should be \LU{0}{\tv_{z1}} as the other two. (3) docs/dev/internals/userItems.md, section 7, the table row of CreateRigidBody: Euler parameter nodes are said to be refused, while userItems.py supports NodeRigidBodyEP (#3238). Found in the analyses of revision2026c steps RG9.14.1 and RG14.6.1.
